boot_initialization_penalty.header: Macro Pipeline: Complex Customer Order Graph Assembly + Execution
boot_initialization_penalty.description: Measures the initial cold startup overhead, script evaluation, context generation, and first-item execution tracks under strict cache-eviction environments.
boot_initialization_penalty.underlyingMechanics: Zod links structural closures inside the runtime thread. Xalor pulls structural tokens synchronously from an AOT JSON blueprint file and streams individual AST nodes into an active global vault map.

cold_start_evaluation.performanceAnalysis: Xalor registers a low bootstrap footprint (~356 ns), outperforming runtime dynamic parsers by up to 1,000x on initial evaluation tracks. This occurs because Xalor relies entirely on raw synchronous string extractions to populate its layout, avoiding heavy JavaScript prototype linking loops or dynamic code evaluation cycles entirely.

tableOFContents.description: An ultra-high-performance, zero-dependency micro-benchmarking engine built directly on top of native V8 runtime hooks and the JavaScript performance timeline API.

underlyingMechanics.jitPreHeating: Executes dead warm-up iterations to force the V8 Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler to optimize function paths before metrics are captured.
underlyingMechanics.clocks: Communicates directly with the host hardware clock via process.hrtime.bigint() to achieve absolute nanosecond precision.
underlyingMechanics.gcIsolation: Utilizes child subprocess forks with explicit global.gc() exposures to capture true memory deltas without runtime telemetry bleed.
